item.title: Green Stocks December 18: Green Stocks Mostly Lower Amid Flat Markets
item.description: Amid flat to mildly negative benchmark indices, cautious investor sentiment was also reflected in renewable energy stocks. Most green energy stocks tracked in our daily analysis closed lower, while a few posted marginal gains. The stocks that advanced were largely concentrated among select solar module manufacturers and EPC companies. item.title: Saudi Arabia Connects World’s Largest 7.8 GWh Energy Storage System to Grid
item.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia has officially completed grid connection of its energy storage system (ESS) project with a nameplate capacity of 7.8 GWh. Once fully energized, it will become one of the world’s largest operational battery energy storage system (BESS). The large-scale project spans three key sites in Saudi Arabia’s southwestern regions - Najran, Khamis Mushait, and Madaya. item.title: Karnataka Leads India’s EV Charging Race as Network Crosses 29,000 Stations
item.description: Total Electric Vehicle (EV) sales in November this year crossed 2.17 lakh units as the sector becomes the most favourable choice for new vehicle buyers. While the dearth of EV charging stations so far restricted the penetration of EVs, the rise of EV charging stations across the landscape of the country has partly alleviated the range anxiety of EV commuters. item.title: US Expected To Install Over 7 GW of Wind Capacity In 2025, 36% More Than 2024
item.description: The United States is expected to add more than 7 gigawatts (GW) of wind power capacity in 2025, a 36% increase from the previous year, according to the latest U.S. Wind Energy Monitor report released by Wood Mackenzie and the American Clean Power Association (ACP). Despite a challenging market environment, the report said the U.S. remains on track to install 46 GW of new wind capacity between 2025 and 2029, with the five-year outlook unchanged from the previous quarter. item.description: SECI has recently issued a tender to set up a 125 MW/500 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) in Odisha and to make an energy storage facility available to GRIDCO for charging and discharging of the BESS on an “on-demand” basis.
